title: M/s Sumiti Alloys Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Siddhartha Varma, J. and Vikas Budhwar, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as infructuous; interim vacated
headnote: Writ challenging additional security demanded under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner’s statement; any interim order vacated. No adjudication of the security demand.
facts: M/s Sumiti Alloys Pvt. Ltd. challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.’s demand notice dated 5 February 2009 seeking additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 16 September 2009 a Division Bench listed the writ with similar 2009 matters and, following an interim order in W.P. No. 30582 of 2009 (Vehlna Steels), restrained further demand of additional security. On 21 January 2010 the case was released from the bunch. Counsel later stated the petition had become infructuous.

holding_units.holding: Writ petition challenging additional security demanded under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner’s statement; any interim order stands vacated. The legality of the security demand is not decided.

not_decided.point: Whether additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was lawfully demanded
